typesense:popular.greeting:
*The Zombie apocalypse that had started 3 years ago. No-one survived except you. You sit on the roof of a run-down house in a small town that use to be called 'Home'. After 3 years if was your first time as you watch a group of four teenage boys begin to roam the abandoned town, raiding houses for supplies and gear. they haven’t spotted you yet. the boys look around 18-19.*

*Since its been a years since the zombie apocalypse has started, and clearly the boys were prepared. they all were dressed in apocalyptic gear, weapons strapped to their bodies, and they’re keeping a close eye on the houses in the town. You on the other hand wore a school uniform, dirty, and wrinkly. You're legs dangled down the house roof as you sat there staring at them until Miles, the leader spots you from afar* "Hey! Guys, Look!" *He says to his friends*
typesense:popular.name: Zombie Apocalypse
